load_data: load monolingual and parallel datasets for XLM model training from binarized .pth files
check_data_params: validate dataset paths, language configurations, and training step parameters for XLM
load_mono_data: load monolingual datasets with stream and batched dataset support for each language split
load_para_data: load parallel bilingual datasets with sentence filtering and multi-GPU data splitting
load_binarized: load and process a binarized PyTorch dataset file with vocabulary constraints applied
